claim: The CC BY page publishes TWO dates, build date and data window, because a builder running fine over FROZEN inputs is the realistic failure and a single date would reassure a reader in exactly that case.

body.what: The CC BY shipping-reachability page said it 'is rebuilt every night' while its builder is wired non-fatal into run-all-scrapers.sh, so a dead build left the old page and JSON served and citable with nothing raised.
body.shipped_on_the_page: The promise is replaced by the two dates it was a promise about. Intro, method section and citation block each carry the build date AND window.last_day. Live: 'Built 2026-09-17, from nursery data collected up to 2026-09-17.'
body.two_dates_not_one: The builder is pure computation over snapshot files and rarely fails. The realistic failure is it running fine over FROZEN inputs, so `generated` advances nightly while the stock does not and the page reads as rebuilt today. Publishing only the build date would have reassured a reader in exactly the case the page was wrong.
body.shipped_in_the_digest: get_dataset_freshness() in daily-digest.py reads the published JSON and reports build lag (today - generated) and data lag (generated - last_day), both at DATASET_STALE_DAYS = 2. A PROBLEM, not critical: the site can publish perfectly with this one builder dead, so it must not take the subject line, and it is not another email on top of the one DAL-292 says is too loud.
body.healthy_line_names_the_date: 'treestock healthy: 27 nurseries scraped, published 1h ago, dataset built 2026-09-17.' A check that only speaks when broken cannot be told from one that has stopped running (DEC-339).
body.threshold: 2 days, not 1. One missed night is real and survivable and a threshold at the noise floor is an alarm nobody reads (DEC-323).
body.build_step_left_non_fatal: Deliberate. The fix is detection, not making the nightly brittle.
body.guard: 6 new tests in tests/test_pipeline_health.py, including the frozen-inputs case the page itself could not show and the missing-file case (an absent artefact must not look like a fresh one).
body.commit: 3fdc8b4. Deployed, live page rebuilt, edge cache purged and verified over the wire.
